top_signals.title: Visible Crude Loadings Halt, Iran’s Empty Tankers Remain Idle Since September
top_signals.summary: No Iran-affiliated tanker still transmitting AIS in the Middle East Gulf has shown a draft change indicative of loading since September 17. Before then, MIOC detected only seven AIS-transmitting tankers loading almost 6 million barrels between July 27 and September 17…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
